unlisted_practices: Involving patient and clinician representatives (PPIE groups) to define what personal and contextual information AI clinical summaries should include
Developing patient-centered gold-standard summary annotation guidelines for evaluating LLM summarization
Few-shot prompting to improve LLM summary quality

screen.reason: The study develops a patient-centered clinical summarization framework and benchmarks several open-source LLMs on transcribed consultations against clinician-annotated gold standard summaries.
